title: Single-event market-model CAR
frame: DIKETAHUI: stock returns [T], market returns [T], event date, estimation [L1 lo, hi], event window [a, b] in trading days. DITANYAKAN: market-model alpha, beta, residual sigma, AR per day, CAR (decimal). RUMUS: Core 1; toolkit market_model(stock_est, market_est), abnormal_returns(..., alpha, beta), car(ar). JAWAB: 1) merge on dates; event date -> row position (next trading day if closed). 2) slice estimation rows by position. 3) OLS a, b; s^2=SSR/(L1-2). 4) AR in window. 5) CAR=sum AR. 6) check windows disjoint, no padded days.
pitfalls: calendar-day windows; overlapping estimation and event windows

title: Multi-event panel: AR matrix, AAR and CAAR
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T x N], market [T], events [E] (id, date), windows. DITANYAKAN: AR [E x L2], CAR [E], AAR and CAAR by relative day. RUMUS: Core 1; toolkit event_study_panel(events, returns, market, est_window, event_window). JAWAB: 1) per event slice by position. 2) skip events lacking minimum estimation obs (state). 3) fit, AR. 4) AAR_t=mean_i AR. 5) CAAR=cumsum AAR. 6) check CAAR at end = mean CAR.

title: Mean-adjusted and market-adjusted abnormal returns
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns, market returns, estimation window, events. DITANYAKAN: AR under constant-mean (R-mean_est) or market-adjusted (R-Rm) models. RUMUS: MacKinlay: mean-adjusted AR=R_t-mean(R_est); market-adjusted AR=R_t-Rm_t (alpha 0, beta 1). JAWAB: 1) pick model per text. 2) estimation mean if needed. 3) AR, CAR. 4) variance of AR from estimation (ddof per text).

title: Fama-French three-factor event-study benchmark
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns, FF factors and RF, events, windows. DITANYAKAN: AR using FF3 expected returns fitted on estimation window. RUMUS: AR=R-RF-(a+b MKT+s SMB+h HML); s^2=SSR/(L1-4). JAWAB: 1) factor units /100. 2) excess returns. 3) OLS per event on estimation rows. 4) AR, CAR. 5) tests with df L1-4.

title: Buy-and-hold abnormal return (BHAR)
deliverables: summary: mean BHAR, t, skewness-adjusted t
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns, benchmark returns (market or matched portfolio), horizon H. DITANYAKAN: BHAR per event and mean. RUMUS: Core 1: BHAR=prod(1+R)-prod(1+R_bench). JAWAB: 1) window positions. 2) compound each. 3) delisting/short histories per text. 4) mean, cross-sectional t; Lyon-Barber-Tsai skewness adjustment if asked.

title: Patell standardized abnormal return test
frame: DIKETAHUI: event ARs, estimation market returns, residual sigma, L_i per event. DITANYAKAN: SAR with C_t correction, SCAR, Patell Z. RUMUS: Core 2; toolkit patell_standardized(ar_event, market_ret_event, mm), patell_test(sars, L_list). JAWAB: 1) s_i from SSR/(L-2). 2) C_t=1+1/L+(Rm_t-mean)^2/sum(Rm_est-mean)^2. 3) SAR. 4) SCAR=sum SAR/sqrt(L2) (card V2 a). 5) Z=sum SCAR/sqrt(sum (L_i-2)/(L_i-4)).

title: BMP standardized cross-sectional test
frame: DIKETAHUI: SCAR per event [E]. DITANYAKAN: BMP t = mean(SCAR)/(std(SCAR,ddof=1)/sqrt E). RUMUS: Core 2; toolkit bmp_test(scars). JAWAB: 1) SCAR per Patell. 2) mean, sd ddof=1. 3) t. 4) p from t(E-1) or normal per text.

title: Kolari-Pynnonen cross-correlation adjustment
frame: DIKETAHUI: BMP t, estimation residuals for all events. DITANYAKAN: average pairwise residual correlation and adjusted statistic. RUMUS: Core 2: t_adj=t_BMP sqrt((1-rho)/(1+(N-1)rho)); toolkit average_residual_correlation, kolari_pynnonen_adjust. JAWAB: 1) residual matrix on common estimation dates. 2) pairwise corr mean (upper triangle). 3) adjust. 4) report both forms if V4 asked.

title: Corrado nonparametric rank test
deliverables: summary: z for day 0 and window
frame: DIKETAHUI: estimation residuals and event ARs per event. DITANYAKAN: rank z statistics. RUMUS: Core 3; toolkit corrado_rank_test(est_resids_list, event_ars_list, event_day_index, window). JAWAB: 1) per event combine estimation+event AR, rank (average ties). 2) U=K/(T_i+1)-0.5. 3) Ubar_t across events per relative day. 4) S over full span incl. gap days (zeros). 5) z0, window z=sum Ubar/(sqrt(L2) S).

title: Sign test and generalized sign test
frame: DIKETAHUI: CAR per event [E]; optionally estimation residuals. DITANYAKAN: binomial sign z; generalized version with estimation-period p_hat. RUMUS: toolkit sign_test(cars, method='binomial' or generalized, est_resids_list, p_hat); z=(w-E p)/sqrt(E p(1-p)). JAWAB: 1) w = count CAR>0. 2) p=0.5 or p_hat = share positive estimation ARs. 3) z. 4) p-value.

title: Cross-sectional t test on CARs
frame: DIKETAHUI: CAR per event [E]. DITANYAKAN: t=CAAR/(std(CAR,ddof=1)/sqrt E). RUMUS: Core 2 plain t; toolkit cross_sectional_t(cars). JAWAB: 1) CARs. 2) mean, std ddof=1. 3) t, p df E-1.

title: Brown-Warner crude dependence adjustment
deliverables: summary: t for day 0 and window
frame: DIKETAHUI: estimation residuals and event ARs per event. DITANYAKAN: t using std of AAR over estimation period. RUMUS: toolkit crude_dependence_t; t=AAR_0/sd(AAR_est), window: sum AAR/(sqrt(L2) sd). JAWAB: 1) AAR per estimation day across events. 2) sd ddof=1. 3) t for day 0 and window.

title: CARs over multiple event windows table
deliverables: table per window: CAAR, t, Patell Z, BMP t, % positive
frame: DIKETAHUI: events, returns, list of windows ([-1,1], [-5,5], [0,10]). DITANYAKAN: per window stats. RUMUS: Core 1-3 for each window from one estimation fit per event. JAWAB: 1) fit once. 2) for each window compute CARs from ARs. 3) stats. 4) table sorted as given.

title: Mapping event timestamps to trading-day positions
frame: DIKETAHUI: events with timestamps, trading calendar. DITANYAKAN: day 0 per event and relative-day index. RUMUS: Card: non-trading date -> next trading day; after-close news -> next day; relative days are positions in the merged index. JAWAB: 1) normalise tz. 2) if time after close (16:00 ET), shift. 3) searchsorted left in sorted trading dates. 4) positions for windows. 5) drop events with insufficient rows.

title: Clustered or overlapping events
frame: DIKETAHUI: events with overlapping windows/dates. DITANYAKAN: calendar-time portfolio alpha or clustered-adjusted stats. RUMUS: Calendar time: each day average return of firms in event window; regress on factors; alpha is abnormal performance. JAWAB: 1) membership per day. 2) EW (or VW) portfolio return. 3) OLS on MKT (FF3). 4) alpha and t. 5) or KP adjustment.

title: Standardised unexpected earnings, time-series (Bernard-Thomas)
frame: DIKETAHUI: quarterly EPS series per firm. DITANYAKAN: SUE=(E_q-E_{q-4})/std of prior seasonal differences. RUMUS: Core 4 time-series form, 4-8 prior quarters. JAWAB: 1) sort by fiscal quarter. 2) d_q=E_q-E_{q-4}. 3) std of prior d (exclude current), min count. 4) SUE. 5) drift term mean(d) per text.

title: Analyst-consensus earnings surprise and beat/miss
frame: DIKETAHUI: actual EPS, consensus, estimate std or price. DITANYAKAN: surprise metrics and classification. RUMUS: Core 4: (A-C)/|C|*100; SUE_analyst=(A-C)/std(estimates) or /price; thresholds strict. JAWAB: 1) compute. 2) classify beat if > threshold, miss if < -threshold strict. 3) |C|=0 -> undefined per text.

title: Post-earnings announcement drift portfolio
frame: DIKETAHUI: SUE per announcement, returns after announcement, holding window. DITANYAKAN: CAR by SUE decile, long-short drift. RUMUS: Sort on SUE at announcement (breakpoints from prior quarter per text); CAR [+2,+60]. JAWAB: 1) SUE. 2) deciles per quarter. 3) CAR per event in window. 4) decile means. 5) D10-D1, t.

title: Regression of announcement CAR on earnings surprise
deliverables: summary: intercept, ERC slope, t, R2
frame: DIKETAHUI: CAR [E], surprise [E], controls. DITANYAKAN: ERC slope. RUMUS: OLS CAR=a+b SUE+c'controls+e; robust se per text. JAWAB: 1) align. 2) winsorise surprise if asked. 3) OLS. 4) White/clustered se. 5) report.

title: 13F holdings: parse, filter and aggregate by CUSIP
deliverables: per manager-quarter holdings: cusip, shares, value, weight
frame: DIKETAHUI: 13F information table rows (CUSIP, VALUE, SSHPRNAMT, SSHPRNAMTTYPE, PUTCALL), filing metadata. DITANYAKAN: aggregated holdings with weights summing 1. RUMUS: Card 13F rules: keep SH, blank PUTCALL, VALUE>0; aggregate by CUSIP; manager=filer CIK (leading zeros). JAWAB: 1) eligible filings (13F-HR, /A, holdings report). 2) filters. 3) VALUE units by filing date. 4) groupby CUSIP sum. 5) weights. 6) check sum 1.

title: 13F amendments: restatement versus new holdings
frame: DIKETAHUI: original and amendment filings with AMENDMENTTYPE, dates, accession. DITANYAKAN: effective holdings after applying amendments in order. RUMUS: Card: order by filing date, amendment no, accession; RESTATEMENT replaces whole report; NEW HOLDINGS appends rows. JAWAB: 1) group by (CIK, period). 2) sort. 3) fold: restatement replaces, new holdings append. 4) apply filters, aggregate. 5) counts.
formulas: book = rows(restatement) or book + rows(new holdings)

title: 13F VALUE units across the 2023 change
frame: DIKETAHUI: 13F rows with VALUE and filing date. DITANYAKAN: values in consistent dollars. RUMUS: Card: thousands before 2023-01-03 filings, whole dollars after. JAWAB: 1) filing date per row. 2) multiply x1000 if earlier. 3) implied price VALUE/shares sanity check. 4) proceed.
formulas: value_usd = VALUE x 1000 if filed < 2023-01-03 else VALUE

title: 13F quarter-over-quarter position changes
deliverables: per CUSIP: shares t-1, t, change, status
frame: DIKETAHUI: aggregated holdings for consecutive quarters. DITANYAKAN: classification new/exit/increase/decrease/unchanged. RUMUS: outer join on CUSIP; missing=0. JAWAB: 1) outer join. 2) delta shares. 3) status rules. 4) counts per status. 5) adjust splits if stated.

title: Holdings turnover between reports
frame: DIKETAHUI: weights at t-1 and t. DITANYAKAN: turnover=0.5 sum|w_t-w_{t-1}| over union. RUMUS: Core 10. JAWAB: 1) union join, fill 0. 2) abs diffs. 3) half sum. 4) check in [0,1].

title: Manager overlap and concentration from holdings
frame: DIKETAHUI: weights per manager over CUSIPs. DITANYAKAN: overlap=sum min(w_i,w_j), HHI, 1/HHI. RUMUS: Core 9. JAWAB: 1) weights per book. 2) pairwise min-sum. 3) HHI=sum w^2. 4) effective N. 5) check HHI in (0,1].

title: Form 4 open-market sale ledger
deliverables: per sale: date, insider, shares, price, value
frame: DIKETAHUI: parsed Form 4 transactions (table, code, A/D, shares, price, shares owned following). DITANYAKAN: sale ledger and total value. RUMUS: Card: sale = Table I, code S, disposed D; inventory before = shares + shares following. JAWAB: 1) filter. 2) value=shares*price. 3) sort by transaction date. 4) totals per insider. 5) check rollforward.

title: Form 4 transaction code classification and net buying
frame: DIKETAHUI: Form 4 rows. DITANYAKAN: per-code counts; net buying = P - S shares. RUMUS: Card codes: P, S, A, D, F, M, X, C, G, J, W. JAWAB: 1) map codes. 2) aggregate. 3) net P minus S (Table I only). 4) buy/sell ratio.

title: Form 4 weighted-average price footnotes
deliverables: per row: reported price, low, high
frame: DIKETAHUI: Form 4 rows with footnotes like price ranges. DITANYAKAN: parsed price ranges and value estimates. RUMUS: Card: footnotes give weighted-average ranges '$lo to $hi'; reported price is the weighted average. JAWAB: 1) regex range. 2) attach to row. 3) value = shares x weighted price. 4) check lo<=price<=hi.

title: Form 4 ownership rollforward, direct and indirect
deliverables: per insider per bucket: start, changes, end
frame: DIKETAHUI: Form 4 rows with ownership D/I and nature. DITANYAKAN: rollforward per ownership bucket. RUMUS: Card: start - sold (+ acquired) = end per bucket. JAWAB: 1) bucket by D or I nature. 2) order by date. 3) start = first before amount. 4) check end matches last shares following.

title: Insider purchase event study
frame: DIKETAHUI: Form 4 purchases (code P), returns, market. DITANYAKAN: CAR around filing (public) date. RUMUS: Event date = filing date (not transaction date); market model Core 1. JAWAB: 1) events from code P rows, dedupe per insider-day. 2) map to trading day. 3) CAR [0,+5] etc. 4) tests.
pitfalls: using transaction date as public date

title: 8-K item classification and event date
deliverables: per filing: items list, report date, filing date, lag
frame: DIKETAHUI: 8-K filing text or header. DITANYAKAN: items present, event date, filing lag in business days. RUMUS: Card item list; Date of Report = event date; due 4 business days. JAWAB: 1) regex 'Item d.dd'. 2) map names. 3) dates. 4) lag np.busday_count. 5) flag late.

title: 8-K debt obligation extraction (Item 2.03)
frame: DIKETAHUI: 8-K text with debt description. DITANYAKAN: principal (USD), rate, maturity. RUMUS: Card: debt principal before over-allotment; units '$653.2 M' -> 653.2e6. JAWAB: 1) parse numbers line by line. 2) units. 3) choose base principal. 4) coupon percent -> decimal.

title: 10-K section extraction
deliverables: per filing: section text, word count
frame: DIKETAHUI: 10-K text. DITANYAKAN: section bounded by item headings, length. RUMUS: Card: anchor on body (last) occurrence of heading, not the TOC. JAWAB: 1) regex headings. 2) last occurrence start, next item end. 3) clean. 4) tokens.

title: Year-over-year 10-K similarity (lazy prices)
frame: DIKETAHUI: consecutive 10-K section texts. DITANYAKAN: cosine (TF or TF-IDF) and Jaccard similarity. RUMUS: cos=a.b/(|a||b|); Jaccard=|A&B|/|A|B|. JAWAB: 1) tokenise same rule. 2) vectors. 3) similarity. 4) sort into quintiles if asked.

title: Inline XBRL numeric facts
frame: DIKETAHUI: iXBRL HTML. DITANYAKAN: numeric values with scale and sign. RUMUS: Card: value x 10^scale; sign='-' negates; '(1,234)' negative. JAWAB: 1) parse ix:nonFraction. 2) strip commas. 3) scale. 4) sign. 5) map context period; first number latest year.
formulas: value = number x 10^scale x (-1 if sign = '-')

title: XBRL dei cover-page facts
deliverables: summary: cik, float, shares, fiscal year
frame: DIKETAHUI: iXBRL with dei tags. DITANYAKAN: cover values. RUMUS: Card: EntityPublicFloat = non-affiliate value. JAWAB: 1) find dei tags. 2) scale. 3) CIK zero-padded 10. 4) report.

title: Loughran-McDonald lexicon tone
deliverables: per document: pos, neg, total tokens, tone
frame: DIKETAHUI: documents, word lists. DITANYAKAN: tone per document. RUMUS: Core 5: lowercase, non-letters -> space, split; (pos-neg)/(pos+neg) or scale(pos-neg)/total. JAWAB: 1) tokenise. 2) count. 3) tone per formula. 4) zero denominators -> 0 per text.

title: Tone surprise versus prior documents
frame: DIKETAHUI: chronological documents with tone. DITANYAKAN: tone - mean of prior K (current excluded). RUMUS: Core 5. JAWAB: 1) order by date. 2) shift then rolling K. 3) min periods per text. 4) surprise.
pitfalls: including current statement in prior mean

title: FOMC statement and yield reaction
deliverables: per meeting: tone, yield change bps
frame: DIKETAHUI: FOMC dates, yields (percent), tone. DITANYAKAN: yield change around meeting in bps, regression on tone. RUMUS: Card: yields in percent -> change*100 = bps; offsets count data rows. JAWAB: 1) map meeting date. 2) change y_{t+k}-y_{t-1}. 3) x100. 4) OLS on tone surprise.

title: TF-IDF novelty of statements
frame: DIKETAHUI: documents chronological. DITANYAKAN: novelty=1-cos(current, mean prior vectors). RUMUS: Core 6 sklearn smooth idf=ln((1+N)/(1+df))+1; tf=count/total tokens. JAWAB: 1) vocab and idf per text (all docs or prior only). 2) vectors. 3) mean prior. 4) cos. 5) novelty.

title: Prediction-market implied probabilities
deliverables: per market: p_yes, p_no, overround, normalised prob
frame: DIKETAHUI: YES/NO prices in cents or decimals. DITANYAKAN: implied probability and overround. RUMUS: Core 7: price/payout; overround = p_yes+p_no-1; normalised p_yes/(p_yes+p_no). JAWAB: 1) units cents -> /100. 2) compute. 3) mid from bid/ask if given.

title: Cross-venue prediction-market arbitrage with fees
deliverables: per pair: gross edge, fees, net edge, pnl
frame: DIKETAHUI: YES price on venue X, NO price on venue Y, fee schedules, quantity. DITANYAKAN: edge and pnl. RUMUS: Core 7: edge=1-(p_yes_X+p_no_Y)-fees; Kalshi fee=ceil_cent(0.07 C P(1-P)). JAWAB: 1) prices decimal. 2) fees per leg. 3) net edge. 4) pnl=qty*edge. 5) check net<=gross.
formulas: fee_kalshi = ceil(100 x 0.07 C P(1 - P))/100

title: Perpetual funding rate annualisation and carry
frame: DIKETAHUI: funding rates per 8h, position size, side. DITANYAKAN: annualised funding, payments. RUMUS: Core 8: annual=rate*3*365; rate>0 longs pay shorts. JAWAB: 1) sum payments = notional*rate*sign. 2) annualise. 3) report.

title: Futures basis and cash-and-carry
frame: DIKETAHUI: F, S, days to expiry. DITANYAKAN: basis and annualised basis. RUMUS: Core 8: (F-S)/S, annualised *365/days. JAWAB: 1) compute. 2) compare with funding or rates. 3) report.

title: ETF holdings dollar exposure and implied price
frame: DIKETAHUI: TNA, weights, shares held. DITANYAKAN: dollar holding and implied price. RUMUS: Core 9. JAWAB: 1) $=TNA*w. 2) price=$/shares. 3) check weights sum ~1.

title: ETF premium or discount to NAV
frame: DIKETAHUI: ETF price, NAV per share. DITANYAKAN: premium=(price-NAV)/NAV. RUMUS: Core 9. JAWAB: 1) align. 2) compute. 3) stats.

title: ETF redemption sell pressure
deliverables: per holding: shares to sell, days of ADV
frame: DIKETAHUI: outflow pct, shares held, ADV. DITANYAKAN: sell shares and liquidation days. RUMUS: Core 9: sell=pct*shares held. JAWAB: 1) sell. 2) days = sell/ADV. 3) rank by days.

title: Abnormal trading volume around events
frame: DIKETAHUI: volume [T], events, windows. DITANYAKAN: abnormal log volume vs estimation mean. RUMUS: AV=ln(1+V_t)-mean(ln(1+V_est)) (or market-model on volume). JAWAB: 1) log transform. 2) estimation mean, sd. 3) AV. 4) standardise.

title: EDGAR filing deadlines and lags
deliverables: per filing: lag, deadline, late flag
frame: DIKETAHUI: event dates and filing dates by form type. DITANYAKAN: deadline compliance. RUMUS: Card: 13F <=45 days after quarter end; Form 4 2 business days; 8-K 4 business days. JAWAB: 1) deadline per form. 2) busday or calendar count. 3) flag.

title: Event study with log returns and missing days
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns with gaps, events. DITANYAKAN: CAR without padding. RUMUS: Card: never pad missing event days; minimum obs threshold. JAWAB: 1) positions on merged index. 2) count valid estimation obs. 3) skip below min. 4) CAR over available ARs per text.

title: Earnings announcement window CAR conditioned on surprise sign
frame: DIKETAHUI: events with surprise, CARs. DITANYAKAN: CAAR per group and difference. RUMUS: Welch t for difference. JAWAB: 1) groups. 2) CAAR. 3) t per group. 4) difference t.
